title: Observe Observation Contract v1
description: Standardized normalized observation emitted by ObservationSource implementations across platform layers.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the observation occurred.

kind.description: Dot-separated event kind label (e.g. run.settled, session.opened, session.closed, work.settled).

attrs.description: Domain-specific attributes associated with this observation event.

source.description: Identifier of the ObservationSource provider (e.g. run-result, coordination, work, transcripts, invocation-faults, repo).
